deviations.what: Spec claim c60 (confirmed) says the batch ships as several smaller PRs opened EARLY so per-PR SonarCloud and Qodo findings exist for the pr-upkeep loop to consume. The PR now comes at the END instead. Consequence, stated plainly: c60 was the MECHANISM behind t17's three-item target. With zero open PRs, the Qodo feed, the per-PR Sonar query and t7's brand-new check-runs source all return nothing, so the sweep's entire supply stays at the 3 main-branch findings measured during the challenge pass. t17 either draws from that thin supply or reports honestly short. The end-of-cycle PR will generate PR-scoped findings, but only after the work it was meant to feed is done.
deviations.reason: Operator decision: the PR is the seal on the work rather than a feed for it. Approved and recorded rather than silently followed, so the delivery summary can explain t17's number instead of the next cycle re-deriving why supply was thin.
